name: Chicken Tenders
steps: Slice the chicken breast into strips.

Set up a breading station with three bowls: one with flour and spices (smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, pepper), one with a beaten egg, and one with a mixture of panko breadcrumbs and crushed cornflakes.
Dredge each chicken strip in the flour mixture, then dip it into the beaten egg, and finally coat it with the breadcrumb mixture.

Air fry the chicken tenders at 200°C for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and cooked through. Alternatively, bake in the oven at 200°C for 15-20 minutes or until fully cooked.

To honey glaze the tenders, mix 80g of siracha, 60g of honey, and 15ml of lemon juice in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat until the mixture is well combined and slightly thickened. Coat the cooked chicken tenders with the honey glaze before serving.
